_**Agent (default)**_

Not as a live canvas. The runtime is Cursor-IDE-only. CLI agents can consume the **source**, not the **surface**.

The [dy call chain](/Users/liamellis/.cursor/projects/Users-liamellis-Desktop-apps-ultraterrestrial-resurrection/canvases/dy-call-chain.canvas.tsx) file sits outside the git tree in Cursor’s project cache (`~/.cursor/projects/…/canvases/`). It imports a virtual `cursor/canvas` module the IDE compiles and hosts beside chat. Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, etc. have no that host: no theme bridge, no canvas compiler, no “open beside chat.”

What they *can* do:

| Want | Works? |
|---|---|
| Read the `.canvas.tsx` as TypeScript | Yes, if you give them the absolute path (or copy/symlink it into the repo) |
| Render the interactive DAG | No |
| Use the same facts | Yes — `apps/disclosure-rag/docs/CALL_CHAIN.md` is already the in-repo source of truth |

Practical ways to share it with CLI agents:

1. **Point them at `CALL_CHAIN.md`.** That is what they should grep. The canvas is a view of that file, not a second SoT.
2. **Add mermaid (or a compact ASCII DAG) into `CALL_CHAIN.md`.** Every markdown-capable CLI sees it. This is the highest-leverage “expose” if the goal is other agents understanding the chain.
3. **Copy or symlink the `.tsx` into the repo** and mention it in `apps/disclosure-rag/CLAUDE.md`. They can read the node tables and edges; they still cannot run it.
4. **Do not expect Cursor CLI to render it either.** Canvas surfaces are documented as IDE/cloud, not CLI.

There is no official “publish this canvas to Claude Code” hook. If you want one artifact both worlds use, put diagrams in the markdown that already lives in git. I can add those mermaid blocks to `CALL_CHAIN.md` if you want that next.

---

No. I wrote the links and did not Cmd-click them, and I did not run a resolver until just now.

I checked 228 hrefs in the files we edited:

- **69** resolve both from the documenting file and from repo root (these should Cmd-click).
- **115** exist only as repo-root paths. From a nested file such as [`apps/app/src/features/mindmap/CLAUDE.md`](apps/app/src/features/mindmap/CLAUDE.md), default markdown resolution looks next to that file, so `docs/archive/...` and `AGENTS.md` miss.
- **10** resolve from neither — including a parser break on `apps/app/src/app/(site)/...` (the `)` in `(site)` ends the markdown link early).

So the original clickable `../file.py` links in `CALL_CHAIN.md` would have worked from that file. The workspace-root hrefs I switched to were not verified in the editor, and most of them will not Cmd-click from nested docs unless Cursor is resolving against the workspace root rather than the markdown file.
